profile.headline: Software Engineer and Motion Graphics Designer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I believe in a world where art and technology walk hand in hand and form and function both have a seat at the table.

Currently I am a full time full stack developer with a focus and passion for front-end and user interaction as well as a freelance motion graphics designer.

I love being able to intertwine my variety of skills to achieve new and better ways of doing things. Whether that's programming scripts to help automate animations and motion work or using my experience with manual animation techniques to achieve more organic and fluid user experiences on the web.

positions.title: Motion Graphics Designer
positions.description:
I am a self employed designer and animator working to help my clients solve problems with the use audible and visual media.

Much of my process involves coming up with new and creative ways of showcasing products or sharing ideas typically with the purpose of informing a large audience.

Well versed in many Adobe Creative Cloud applications, including: After Effects, Premiere Pro, Audition, Photoshop, and Illustrator. Along with experience in 3D applications like Cinema 4d and blender.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack developer on several large scale customer facing applications with a focus on creating easy to use and intuitive experiences to reduce user frustration and call volume.

I am a part of a high performance agile team that is constantly working towards improving the end user experience, which involves working side by side with other developers, designers, and product owners to achieve our goals as fast possible.

On a daily basis I am using multiple different front end technologies including: vanilla.js, node, angular, ember, sass, handlebars, etc.

positions.title: Motion Graphics Designer
positions.description: I create videos that cater to things such as sales videos, demos, and tutorials.

positions.title: Assistant Scene Designer
positions.description:
My role was to help the lead scene designer take a more modern approach to conceptualizing stage designs for the play 'Sunday in the Park with George'.

This involved taking autocad designs from the lead designer and preparing them for a laser cutter so that we could have perfectly cut materials to make a 1:24 scale model of the stage. We could then easily iterate on designs by having multiple custom made pieces to pop in and out.

I also used these designs to recreate a virtual 3D model of the stage and set pieces so we could see how light would interact with the stage as well as projections from our projection artist.
